name: gcc
description: GNU Compiler Collection, providing the GCC (C) and G++ (C++) compilers along with supporting runtime libraries such as libgcc, libstdc++, and libatomic.
build: cd gcc-15.2.0/build && unset CFLAGS CXXFLAGS && ../configure --prefix="$PREFIX" --with-gmp="$PREFIX" --with-mpfr="$PREFIX" --with-mpc="$PREFIX" LD=ld --enable-languages=c,c++ --enable-default-pie --enable-default-ssp --enable-host-pie --disable-multilib --disable-bootstrap --disable-fixincludes --with-system-zlib
cd gcc-15.2.0/build && unset CFLAGS CXXFLAGS && make $MAKEOPTS
